## Software

The lab releases code, teaching notebooks, and reproducible project material through the [ECLIPSE Lab GitHub organization](https://github.com/ECLIPSE-Lab).

::: {.resource-grid}
::: {.resource-card}
### [MSPT_code](https://github.com/ECLIPSE-Lab/MSPT_code)

Code for multi-slice electron ptychographic tomography in three-dimensional phase-contrast microscopy beyond conventional depth-of-focus limits.

`Python` `ptychography` `tomography`
:::

::: {.resource-card}
### [End2EndPtychoTomo_code](https://github.com/ECLIPSE-Lab/End2EndPtychoTomo_code)

Reproducible code for end-to-end ptychographic electron tomography and near-isotropic sub-angstrom 3D phase-contrast imaging.

`Python` `4D-STEM` `reconstruction`
:::

::: {.resource-card}
### [PtychographicElectronTomography2023](https://github.com/ECLIPSE-Lab/PtychographicElectronTomography2023)

Project code and supporting material for solving complex nanostructures with ptychographic atomic electron tomography.

`electron tomography` `atomic structure`
:::

::: {.resource-card}
### [marimo](https://github.com/ECLIPSE-Lab/marimo)

Interactive marimo notebooks and small apps from the group for computational microscopy workflows, demonstrations, and teaching.

`notebooks` `interactive`
:::
:::

More repositories are available at [github.com/ECLIPSE-Lab](https://github.com/ECLIPSE-Lab).

## Presentations & Teaching

::: {.resource-grid}
::: {.resource-card}
### [Lecture slides & course materials](https://pelzlab.science/public_presentations/)

Slides, decks, and public course presentations from the ECLIPSE Lab teaching programme.
:::

::: {.resource-card}
### [Data Science for Electron Microscopy](https://github.com/ECLIPSE-Lab/DataScienceForElectronMicroscopy)

Lecture website and notebooks for data-driven electron microscopy, including practical computational microscopy material.
:::

::: {.resource-card}
### [Machine Learning for Characterization and Processing](https://github.com/ECLIPSE-Lab/MachineLearningForCharacterizationAndProcessing)

Course material on machine learning methods for experimental materials characterization and processing data.
:::
:::

## Datasets

Public dataset releases are being prepared alongside reproducible code packages.

::: {.resource-grid}
::: {.resource-card}
### [EMDatasets](https://github.com/ECLIPSE-Lab/EMDatasets)

Repository for electron microscopy datasets and dataset utilities from the lab.

`released repository`
:::

::: {.resource-card}
### Ptychographic tomography benchmark data

Benchmark datasets connected to ptychographic atomic electron tomography publications, intended for reproducibility and method comparison.

`planned release`
:::

::: {.resource-card}
### HyperScaleEM scale-bridging datasets

Large-volume 4D-STEM and hyperspectral electron tomography datasets generated through the HyperScaleEM project.

`coming soon`
:::
:::
